articles.title: Battleclad Chariot
articles.intro: The final boss on floor 7 of the original Zhayolm Remnants.
articles.body_html:
Reach and defeat

  1. Enter Zhayolm Remnants through the original Salvage route. Follow the floor guide, restore your equipment and abilities with cells, and reach floor 7.
  2. Discoid splits a large magic-damage total among nearby targets. Keep the intended participants close to the main target so they share the damage; use Shell and Stoneskin.
  3. Discoid can be stunned, but repeated Stun attempts build resistance. Do not rely on an endless Stun chain.
  4. Win for the Star Charioteer title, required by An Imperial Heist.

Armor drops

Bodb's Slops, Ea's Crackows, Freyr's Gloves, Phobos's Cuisses, Tsukikazu Jinpachi, Tsukikazu Togi. These are level-25 components for the original Salvage armor upgrades; they are not the finished level-75 pieces.

articles.title: Long-Armed Chariot
articles.intro: The final boss on floor 5 of the original Silver Sea Remnants.
articles.body_html:
Reach and defeat

  1. Enter Silver Sea Remnants and follow its Salvage floor route to the fifth floor.
  2. Watch for Brainjack: it Charms a target and adds damage over time, often in repeated sequences. When the boss turns toward you, swap to a harmless weapon if possible.
  3. Keep Regen on tanks. Uncharmed players should control charmed allies with Bind or Gravity and avoid being hit by them.
  4. Win for Moon Charioteer, one of the titles needed for An Imperial Heist.

Armor drops

Bodb's Cuffs, Ea's Brais, Freyr's Jerkin, Freyr's Mask, Phobos's Gauntlets, Tsukikazu Sune-Ate. These are level-25 components for the original Salvage armor upgrades; they are not the finished level-75 pieces.

articles.title: Long-Bowed Chariot
articles.intro: The final boss on floor 5 of the original Bhaflau Remnants.
articles.body_html:
Reach and defeat

  1. Follow the Bhaflau Remnants route. On floor 4, defeat all ten Archaic Gear before they escape to weaken the boss’s Homing Missile and remove its enmity-reset effect.
  2. Reach floor 5. Avoid standing directly in front of the boss, where Homing Missile can be used; recover HP and control enmity promptly after a missile.
  3. Prepare for strong physical hits and multiple attacks. Stun resistance builds quickly, so prioritize dangerous moves.
  4. Victory grants Comet Charioteer for An Imperial Heist.

Armor drops

Bodb's Crown, Bodb's Robe, Ea's Dastanas, Freyr's Ledelsens, Phobos's Mask, Phobos's Cuirass, Tsukikazu Haidate. These are level-25 components for the original Salvage armor upgrades; they are not the finished level-75 pieces.

articles.title: Armored Chariot
articles.intro: The boss on floor 7 of the original Arrapago Remnants.
articles.body_html:
Reach and defeat

  1. Enter the original Arrapago Remnants Salvage route and follow the floor guide to the seventh floor. Allocate cells so your tank and healer regain their essential equipment and abilities.
  2. Prepare for Mortal Revolution: area damage with Stun. Keep Utsusemi shadows available where possible and keep support out of unnecessary area attacks.
  3. Defeat the boss and collect its armor components. Use An Imperial Heist to track the required original Salvage boss clears.

Armor drops

Bodb's Pigaches, Ea's Doublet, Ea's Tiara, Freyr's Trousers, Phobos's Sabatons, Tsukikazu Gote. These are level-25 components for the original Salvage armor upgrades; they are not the finished level-75 pieces.

articles.title: Sangoma Lappa
articles.intro: Level-74 leg armor: DEF 35, MP +12, INT +6 and Evasion +3.
articles.body_html:
Who can equip it

MNK / WHM / BLM / RDM / THF / BST / BRD / RNG / NIN / SMN / BLU / PUP / DNC / SCH.

How to obtain

  1. Travel to Castle Oztroja (S). Hunt the past-area version of Zhuu Buxu the Silent, a lottery from Yagudo Sentinels near H-10 on the first map.
  2. Defeat the NM for a chance at the drop. The low-level Giddeus version drops Parana Shield instead.
  3. Alternatively, check the Auction House under Armor → Legs. Availability depends on sellers.

articles.title: Percipient Zoraal Ja
articles.intro: A Beastmaster Mamool Ja who joins the Zoraal Ja’s Pkuucha fight in Wajaom Woodlands.
articles.body_html:
Spawn and battle order

  1. Find Zoraal Ja's Pkuucha through the Lesser Colibri lottery near I-9 in Wajaom Woodlands.
  2. Damage the bird until Percipient Zoraal Ja appears; the bird’s HP recovers when he arrives.
  3. Defeat Percipient first. His Reward-style ability repeatedly restores the bird, preventing you from finishing it while he remains active.
  4. Control the bird with Bind if needed, then finish it after the Mamool Ja dies.

Where the loot comes from

Zoraal Ja's Axe and Fowling Earring drop from the bird, not Percipient. There is no separate pop item for him.

articles.title: Sicklemoon Salt
articles.intro: A temporary key item for reaching the Tinnin battle island.
articles.body_html:
Obtain and use

  1. Ask Ryo about islets in Aht Urhgan Whitegate E-8.
  2. Buy Sicklemoon Salt from Sanraku for 500 Zeni under the classic rules. Each participant needs their own key item.
  3. Examine the Engraved Tablet in Wajaom Woodlands at H-13 to travel to the island.
  4. Gather the party before spawning Tinnin. The salt grants access; the boss still requires its separate trigger. See Zeni Notorious Monsters.
